items.title: Earnings live updates: Cava stock falls after cyclospora outbreak dented Q3 results
items.summary: The third quarter earnings season is over halfway done, and the reports continue to pour in.

items.title: McDonald’s US CMO steps down as sales decline
items.summary: As the fast-food giant searches for a new marketing leader, it will split the role between two longtime executives on an interim basis.

items.title: McDonald's Stock Rally Runs Into Wall Street Warning
items.summary: Oppenheimer sees stretched technicals after McDonald's shares surged more than 20%.

items.title: McDonald's plans new value menu offerings next year to boost sluggish sales
items.summary: McDonald's is testing new value menu constructs in 1,900 restaurants, with CEO Christopher Kempczinski eyeing a national launch in early 2027.

items.title: McDonald’s Q3 Report Draws Price Target Hikes Across Wall Street – Freedom Broker Has A Different Take
items.summary: Freedom Broker downgraded McDonald’s to ‘Hold’ from ‘Buy’ and cut its price target to $298 from $305, citing valuation after a 6.5% post-earnings rally, according to The Fly.

items.title: McDonald's plans to cook up new affordable menu bundles
items.summary: McDonald's CEO Christopher Kempczinski said the company is testing new value pairings at select U.S. locations.

items.title: McDonald’s is changing how it collects customer feedback
items.summary: Customers will be able to leave reviews inside the McDonald’s app, marking “significant enhancements” to feedback collection efforts, CEO Chris Kempczinski said.

items.title: Krispy Kreme raises guidance as turnaround plan gains steam
items.summary: Free cash flow improved by $82 million as the doughnut chain refranchises, cuts capital spending, and prunes underperforming delivery doors.
